rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when you figure something out or establish the facts.

example.english: I still haven't been able to determine why this happened.
example.traditional: 我仲未搞清楚件事點解會咁。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung6 mei6 gaau2 cing1 co2 gin6 si6 dim2 gaai2 wui5 gam2

rows.note: Use this for deciding to do something, or for the general sense of deciding or settling an issue.

example.english: I determine whether we go in the end.
example.jyutping: zeoi3 hau6 jau4 ngo5 kyut3 ding6 heoi3 m4 heoi3

rows.note: Use this specifically when a court or other authority formally rules on a case or issue.

example.english: The court will determine whether the defendant is guilty.
example.traditional: 法庭將裁定被告是否有罪。
example.jyutping: faat3 ting4 zoeng1 coi4 ding6 bei6 gou3 si6 fau2 jau5 zeoi6
